_doc: 藥物頁人工查核紀錄（單一真實來源；2026-11-12 建，核心流程比照 TwTxGNN docs/_data/drug_reviews.json，欄位相同）。每筆＝一次查核：drug／file／claim（頁面原句）／replacement（更正後）／note（頁面上顯示的說明，用本站語言）／finding（內部查證結論）／sources（網址＋查閱日）／checked（查核日）／action（correct 更正｜annotate 加註｜rereview 待重審｜section 附來源段落｜rereview_result 重審結果｜header_level｜description_level）。由 scripts/apply_drug_reviews.py 套到 docs/_drugs/*.md；改寫頁面的程式結尾都會重套，scripts/check_seo_docs.py 第 19 項擋未套用的紀錄。原則：基本事實照主管機關資料更正；模型預測原文不刪不改寫，只加註；證據等級與決策只在重審結果為降級、升級或撤回時更新。2026-10-31～11-06 正文裡跟許可證事實矛盾、直接刪掉的子句，2026-11-12 由 scripts/reviews_from_edits.py 依 git 前後版本轉入（id 以 <站碼>-lic- 開頭）；報告在 11 月經 AI 重產、原句已不在頁面的標 status=resolved_by_regeneration。同 id 重發時前版存進 history（retired、reason），不覆蓋丟棄。

Squibb & Sons, L.L.C.](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=0836c6ac-ee37-5640-2fed-a3185a0b16eb), versão de 2025-11-13; acessado em 2026-11-19).

sources.excerpt: LIPITOR is a selective, competitive inhibitor of HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme that converts 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A to mevalonate, a precursor of sterols, including cholesterol. In animal models, LIPITOR lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase and cholesterol synthesis in the liver and by increasing the number of hepatic LDL receptors on the cell surface to enhance uptake and catabolism of LDL; LIPITOR also reduces LDL production and the number of LDL particles.
sources.translation: LIPITOR é um inibidor seletivo e competitivo da HMG-CoA redutase, a enzima limitante da velocidade que converte a 3-hidroxi-3-metilglutaril-coenzima A em mevalonato, um precursor de esteróis, incluindo o colesterol. Em modelos animais, LIPITOR reduz os níveis plasmáticos de colesterol e de lipoproteínas por meio da inibição da HMG-CoA redutase e da síntese de colesterol no fígado e do aumento do número de receptores hepáticos de LDL na superfície celular, intensificando a captação e o catabolismo do LDL; LIPITOR também reduz a produção de LDL e o número de partículas de LDL.
